## Error workflow

Registered as `errorWorkflow` in the digest workflow's settings — n8n runs it whenever that workflow's execution fails.

Same job as the agent's `recovery` skill: one short Russian Telegram message naming the step that broke. No stack traces, no retries, no second delivery attempt.

nodes.name: On workflow error
nodes.notes: Set as `errorWorkflow` in the digest workflow's settings.

nodes.name: Config: recovery
nodes.notes: Same two values as the digest workflow's Config. telegramChatId must be set.

nodes.name: MCP: notify user
nodes.notes: One user-visible outcome per failure, exactly like the agent's recovery path.
